resource.name: Entra Test
resource.description: Test resource for the MsGraph connector build against a real Entra test tenant. Inbound: enterprise applications are imported as orgs under "Enterprise Applications", groups as roles (Entra Group archetype) assigned to the application orgs they are granted to, directory role definitions as roles (Entra Role archetype), and users as users holding the roles of their groups and directory roles. Outbound (Entra groups only, via MR:RES:EntraTest:Group): an Entra Group role created in midPoint creates an Entra security group (name, mailNickname, type set on create only), the group is assigned to the enterprise applications whose orgs the role is assigned to, and role holders become group members. Enterprise applications, directory roles and user attributes stay inbound only. Group members and application assignments are fetched explicitly.

objectType.description: Entra users imported as midPoint users. Membership in groups is read through the account's memberOfGroup.

inbound.name: entra-user-name
inbound.description: Sets the user name from the Entra userPrincipalName.
inbound.documentation: The userPrincipalName is unique in the tenant and is the login of the person, so it becomes the midPoint user name and is also the correlation key.

inbound.name: entra-user-givenName
inbound.description: Sets the user's given name from the Entra givenName.
inbound.documentation: Entra is authoritative for the given name of the imported test users.

inbound.name: entra-user-familyName
inbound.description: Sets the user's family name from the Entra surname.
inbound.documentation: Entra is authoritative for the family name of the imported test users.

inbound.name: entra-user-fullName
inbound.description: Sets the user's full name from the Entra displayName.
inbound.documentation: The display name shown in Entra is used as the person's full name in midPoint.

inbound.name: entra-user-emailAddress
inbound.description: Sets the user's e-mail address from the Entra mail attribute.
inbound.documentation: The primary Entra mailbox address is the user's e-mail address in midPoint.

inbound.name: entra-user-administrativeStatus
inbound.description: Sets the user's administrative status from the Entra accountEnabled flag.
inbound.documentation: An Entra account that is enabled makes the midPoint user enabled; a disabled Entra account makes the user disabled. When Entra does not report the flag the status is left unset.

inbound.name: entra-user-group-role-assignment
inbound.description: Assigns the user every imported Entra group role whose identifier is one of the group ids the account is member of.
inbound.documentation: A user who is a member of an Entra group holds the midPoint role that represents that group. Groups that were not imported yet produce no assignment; roles are never created on demand from a user import. When the user already holds the role through an assignment made in midPoint (no entra-test-group subtype), no second, tagged assignment is created: the membership already has a midPoint source. Evaluated only when synchronizing from Entra (import, reconciliation, live sync), never during a change made in midPoint: otherwise removing a role in midPoint would be undone in the same operation by the membership Entra still reports, before the removal reaches Entra.

script.code:
import com.evolveum.midpoint.prism.query.ObjectQuery import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.AssignmentType import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.ObjectReferenceType import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.RoleType
String GROUP_ARCHETYPE = '2d83df47-aa0e-4129-827d-70b53a884a4d' String SUBTYPE = 'entra-test-group'
String groupId = basic.stringify(input)?.trim() if (!groupId) { return null } ObjectQuery query = prismContext.queryFor(RoleType.class) .item(RoleType.F_IDENTIFIER).eq(groupId) .and().item(RoleType.F_ARCHETYPE_REF).ref(GROUP_ARCHETYPE) .build() List<RoleType> roles = midpoint.searchObjects(RoleType.class, query) if (roles?.size() != 1) { return null } String roleOid = roles[0].getOid() boolean assignedInMidpoint = focus?.getAssignment()?.any { AssignmentType a -> a?.getTargetRef()?.getOid() == roleOid && !a.getSubtype().contains(SUBTYPE) } ?: false if (assignedInMidpoint) { return null } AssignmentType assignment = new AssignmentType() assignment.setTargetRef(new ObjectReferenceType().oid(roleOid).type(RoleType.COMPLEX_TYPE)) assignment.getSubtype().add(SUBTYPE) return assignment

inbound.name: entra-user-directory-role-assignment
inbound.description: Assigns the user every imported Entra directory role whose identifier is one of the role definition ids the account holds.
inbound.documentation: A user with an active Entra directory role assignment holds the midPoint role that represents that role definition. Only direct, active role assignments are reported by Entra; the implicit default "User" role of every member user is not. Roles that were not imported yet produce no assignment; roles are never created on demand. When the user already holds the role through an assignment made in midPoint (no entra-test-role subtype), no second, tagged assignment is created. Evaluated only when synchronizing from Entra (import, reconciliation, live sync), never during a change made in midPoint, so that removing a role in midPoint is not undone by the stale role assignment Entra still reports.

String ROLE_ARCHETYPE = '8a320ffe-4835-4499-bce9-62aa74bf66df' String SUBTYPE = 'entra-test-role'

association.description: Entra group membership (read only; resolved to role assignments by the memberOfGroup inbound).

Entra directory role assignments at tenant scope. Written by the order-2 inducement of MR:RES:EntraTest:DirectoryRole through the role's members (one roleAssignment per principal); read back through the memberOfRole inbound.

outbound.name: entra-user-keep-account
outbound.description: Keeps the Entra account for as long as the user exists in midPoint.
outbound.documentation: The account construction comes only from Entra group roles (order 2 of MR:RES:EntraTest:Group). Under relative enforcement, removing the last such role would make the account illegal and delete it; this mapping makes the account legal whenever the user exists, so losing a group role only removes the membership.

filter.name: entra-user-by-upn
filter.description: Matches the account to the user whose name equals the Entra userPrincipalName.
filter.documentation: The user name is the UPN (see entra-user-name), so an exact name match is the only correlation rule needed for the test tenant.

objectType.description: Entra groups imported as roles, with their members and the enterprise applications they are assigned to.

inbound.name: entra-group-identifier
inbound.description: Sets the role identifier to the Entra group object id.
inbound.documentation: The Entra object id is the stable, unique key of a group; it is the correlation key and the value that user memberships refer to.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-name
outbound.description: Sets the ConnId name of a new Entra group to the role display name, or the role name when it has none.
outbound.documentation: midPoint requires icfs:name on create; the connector ignores it for groups and uses displayName instead (see entra-group-out-displayName). Weak: only applies on create.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-displayName
outbound.description: Sets the display name of a new Entra group to the role display name, or the role name when it has none.
outbound.documentation: Weak: midPoint names the group when it creates it, while Entra stays authoritative for the name afterwards (the strong inbound entra-group-displayName). Groups that already exist in Entra are never renamed by midPoint.

inbound.name: entra-group-displayName
inbound.description: Sets the role display name from the Entra group displayName.
inbound.documentation: The Entra display name is shown as the role display name. The unique role name is derived from it by the Entra test naming template, whose iteration resolves duplicate names.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-mailNickname
outbound.description: Derives the mail nickname of a new Entra group from the role display name or name.
outbound.documentation: Graph requires mailNickname on create even for security groups that are not mail-enabled. Allowed are ASCII letters, digits and . - _ only, at most 64 characters, so every other character becomes a dash. Weak: set on create only.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-securityEnabled
outbound.description: Creates every Entra group as a security group.
outbound.documentation: Only security groups can be assigned to enterprise applications. Weak: set on create only, existing groups keep their type.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-mailEnabled
outbound.description: Creates every Entra group without a mailbox.
outbound.documentation: Graph cannot create mail-enabled security groups; it requires mailEnabled=false for them. Weak: set on create only.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-description
outbound.description: Sets the description of a new Entra group from the role description.
outbound.documentation: Weak: set on create only; Entra stays authoritative afterwards (strong inbound entra-group-description). Line breaks and indentation (e.g. from a role written as XML) are collapsed into single spaces, because Entra shows the description as one line.

inbound.name: entra-group-description
inbound.description: Sets the role description from the Entra group description.
inbound.documentation: Entra is authoritative for the description of the imported group roles.

attribute.description: Object ids of the enterprise applications the group is assigned to.

outbound.name: entra-group-out-applications
outbound.description: Assigns the Entra group to every enterprise application whose org the role is assigned to.
outbound.documentation: A role placed under an enterprise application org (an assignment to an org with the Entra enterprise application archetype) grants its group access to that application: the value is the org identifier, which is the service principal object id. Evaluated per assignment, so removing the role from the org removes the group from the application. Other application assignments that exist only in Entra are kept (tolerant attribute).

inbound.name: entra-group-application-org-assignment
inbound.description: Assigns the role to every imported enterprise application org whose identifier is one of the application ids the group is assigned to.
inbound.documentation: A group that is assigned to an Entra enterprise application becomes a member of the org representing that application, so the org tree shows which groups grant access to which application. Applications that were not imported yet produce no assignment; orgs are never created on demand. When the role is already placed under the application org by an assignment made in midPoint (no entra-test-application subtype), no second, tagged assignment is created. Evaluated only when synchronizing from Entra (import, reconciliation, live sync), never during a change made in midPoint, so that removing the role from the application org in midPoint is not undone before the removal reaches Entra.

import com.evolveum.midpoint.prism.query.ObjectQuery import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.AssignmentType import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.ObjectReferenceType import com.evolveum.midpoint.xml.ns._public.common.common_3.OrgType
String APP_ARCHETYPE = '2b89648a-2925-45ee-8cfd-d9965e050d1c' String SUBTYPE = 'entra-test-application'
String applicationId = basic.stringify(input)?.trim() if (!applicationId) { return null } ObjectQuery query = prismContext.queryFor(OrgType.class) .item(OrgType.F_IDENTIFIER).eq(applicationId) .and().item(OrgType.F_ARCHETYPE_REF).ref(APP_ARCHETYPE) .build() List<OrgType> orgs = midpoint.searchObjects(OrgType.class, query) if (orgs?.size() != 1) { return null } String orgOid = orgs[0].getOid() boolean assignedInMidpoint = focus?.getAssignment()?.any { AssignmentType a -> a?.getTargetRef()?.getOid() == orgOid && !a.getSubtype().contains(SUBTYPE) } ?: false if (assignedInMidpoint) { return null } AssignmentType assignment = new AssignmentType() assignment.setTargetRef(new ObjectReferenceType().oid(orgOid).type(OrgType.COMPLEX_TYPE)) assignment.getSubtype().add(SUBTYPE) return assignment

attribute.description: Display names of the enterprise applications the group is assigned to.

outbound.name: entra-group-keep-group
outbound.description: Keeps the Entra group for as long as its role exists in midPoint.
outbound.documentation: The group construction comes from the metarole assignment. Losing that assignment must not delete the Entra group; only deleting the role itself does.

filter.name: entra-group-by-object-id
filter.description: Matches the group to the role whose identifier equals the Entra group object id.
filter.documentation: Group display names are not unique in the tenant, so only the immutable object id is used for correlation.

objectType.description: Entra directory role definitions (User, Global Administrator, ...) imported as roles with the Entra Role archetype.

inbound.name: entra-role-identifier
inbound.description: Sets the role identifier to the Entra role definition id.
inbound.documentation: The role definition id is stable and unique (for built-in roles it equals the template id); it is the correlation key and the value user memberOfRole refers to.

inbound.name: entra-role-displayName
inbound.description: Sets the role display name from the Entra role definition displayName.
inbound.documentation: The Entra display name is shown as the role display name. The unique role name is derived from it by the Entra test naming template, whose iteration resolves names already taken by other roles (for example an Entra group with the same name).

inbound.name: entra-role-description
inbound.description: Sets the role description from the Entra role definition description.
inbound.documentation: Entra is authoritative for the description of the imported directory roles.

filter.name: entra-role-by-definition-id
filter.description: Matches the directory role to the role whose identifier equals the Entra role definition id.
filter.documentation: Only the immutable role definition id is used for correlation; display names can collide with group roles.

objectType.description: Entra enterprise applications (service principals) imported as orgs under Enterprise Applications.

inbound.name: entra-app-identifier
inbound.description: Sets the org identifier to the Entra service principal object id.
inbound.documentation: The service principal object id is the stable, unique key of an enterprise application; it is the correlation key and the value group application assignments refer to.

inbound.name: entra-app-parent-org
inbound.description: Places every imported enterprise application org under the Enterprise Applications root org.
inbound.documentation: All enterprise applications live in one branch of the org tree, directly below "Enterprise Applications", so they can be browsed together.

inbound.name: entra-app-displayName
inbound.description: Sets the org display name from the Entra application displayName.
inbound.documentation: The Entra display name is shown as the org display name. The unique org name is derived from it by the Entra test naming template, whose iteration resolves duplicate names.

attribute.description: Object ids of the groups assigned to the application.

filter.name: entra-app-by-object-id
filter.description: Matches the application to the org whose identifier equals the Entra service principal object id.
filter.documentation: Application display names can repeat, so only the immutable object id is used for correlation.
